verdict.rationale: Community discussion confirms Hyperbrowser has public credit/browser-time pricing (comm-1, comm-2, comm-10) and that some limits like concurrency exist, but no first-party docs page defining rate/concurrency limits appears in evidence, and users explicitly call the credit-based pricing confusing and hard to compare against competitors. Missing for 10: a documented pricing page with per-task/per-hour rates, an explicit rate/concurrency limits doc, and independent confirmation that pricing is actually transparent rather than 'confusing'.
